detail: Waiting for the machining station
Move above the raw material tray
Lower the gripper to the workpiece
Close gripper and attach raw workpiece
Lift the workpiece to the safe transfer height
Transfer the workpiece above the machine
Lower the workpiece into the fixture
Open gripper and place the workpiece
Lift clear of the machining station
Park outside the machining area
Request machining after the arm retreats
Wait for the machining completion signal
Move above the finished workpiece
Lower gripper to the finished workpiece
Grip and attach the finished workpiece
Lift the finished workpiece
Return the finished workpiece above the tray
Lower the finished workpiece into its tray slot
Release the finished workpiece
Lift clear of the tray
Return home with gripper open
Finished workpiece verified in tray; arm returned home
